connor: Heads-up — novum14b (int4) canary started failing at ~21:05 UTC after we flipped adaptive-window batching on prod-canary. Seeing intermittent OOMs + repeated slab fragmentation. :frowning:
marie: ack. any quick logs or stack traces? is this coldstart-only or steady-state? :eyes:
connor: calling out two patterns: 1) long generations (>600 tokens) hit OOM when concurrent requests >3, 2) coldstart ramp shows big slab churn and ~2-3s latency spikes. repro logs attached inline:
connor: ```
[2026-03-23T21:06:12Z] alloc_slab: free=5.2GB used=26.8GB frag=18%
[2026-03-23T21:06:13Z] kv_cache: miss prefetched=0 slots=128
[2026-03-23T21:06:13Z] oom: requested=2.1GB available=1.8GB
kernel: blk_alloc failed at 0x7f9c
```
sam: interesting. what's current default max_new_tokens for novum14b? we set 1024 for parity with other 14b models.
jia: 1024 is large for int4 on this architecture + adaptive-window. Suggest temporarily lowering to 512 for canary and see if OOMs stop. also check `prefetch_multiplier` (we used 1.5) — that can increase slab pressure.
connor: tried a quick canary with max_new_tokens=512 and prefetch_multiplier=1.0 — fewer OOMs but still one incident at 21:12. suspect KV prefetch race + slab allocator not consolidating small free regions.
marie: can you paste the canary job config? maybe microbatch or cwnd settings are allowing big bursts.
connor: ```
model: novum14b-int4
batching:
  mode: adaptive-window
  window_ms: 12
  max_batch_tokens: 8192
prefetch_multiplier: 1.0
max_new_tokens: 512
cwnd: 8
```
infra-bot: deploy-canary novum14b-int4 -> started canary node pool (3/3) at 2026-03-23T21:09:03Z
sam: try two things: a) tighten window_ms to 6ms to reduce burst coalescing, b) enable slab compaction pass on allocator every N seconds (we have allocator flag compact_interval_ms). c) reduce kv_cache_prefetch_slots to 64.
jia: agreed. also add a soft-evict policy for KV entries older than 30s during warmup. that prevents huge prefetched KV during long generations.
connor: rolling a canary with window_ms=6, compact_interval_ms=2000, kv_cache_slots=64. will monitor.
connor: side note: quality regressions — at max_new_tokens=512 we saw negligible quality drop on eval set A (delta F1 -0.2), so it's acceptable short-term.
marie: good. if this stabilizes, we should bake a model profile: recommended defaults = {max_new_tokens:512, window_ms:6, prefetch_multiplier:1.0, kv_slots:64, compact_interval_ms:2000}. add to model-catalog as novum14b-int4-profile-v1.
sam: if still unstable, fallback plan is to route novum requests to novum14b-int6 (hybrid) for heavy-gen users until we fix allocator.
connor: canary looks cleaner so far — no OOMs in last 10m. i'll run a 1h smoke with synthetic 700-token workload and report.
deploy-bot: canary-health-check: all checks passing (latency p95 220ms, error rate 0.6%) at 2026-03-23T21:20:01Z :thumbsup:
connor: thanks — will follow up with perf numbers + add a small repro harness to repo under evals/novum14b/hotstart-defrag. planning to open RFC for allocator compaction improvement if flaky recurs. :rocket:
